user.title: Add your SEN65 monitor
user.description: Enter the board's local address. Its dashboard appears automatically in the HA sidebar, including when HA uses HTTPS. No Cloudflare or certificate setup is needed. Keep the ESPHome integration if you also want sensor entities.

reconfigure.title: Update the board address
reconfigure.description: Use the new LAN address of the same board.

error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant cannot reach this board. Check its LAN address, Wi-Fi and firewall.
error.invalid_board: Enter a private LAN address for a compatible SEN65 monitor. This also appears if the address belongs to a different board.

abort.not_supported: This device does not provide the compatible SEN65 dashboard API.
